items.title: Bond Rout Could Provide Opportunity for Investors
items.summary: More than that percentage of the global bond market now yields above 4%, according to BlackRock.  The asset manager says the average yield in a bond portfolio it tracks has more than doubled from five years earlier.  A global bond market rout today pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to 5% for the first time since 2023.
